findings.title: Service has no selector and no endpoints
findings.cause: Service payments has no selector and no EndpointSlice of its own: EndpointSlice payments-1, named for it, lacks the label kubernetes.io/service-name: payments, which is the only link between a slice and its Service, so kube-proxy and DNS never use its addresses and connections to the Service fail

evidence.command: kubectl get service payments -n kd-endpointslice-unlabelled -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

evidence.what: EndpointSlice payments-1 has no kubernetes.io/service-name label
evidence.command: kubectl get endpointslice payments-1 -n kd-endpointslice-unlabelled -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels}'

findings.fix: Label it: kubectl label endpointslice payments-1 -n kd-endpointslice-unlabelled kubernetes.io/service-name=payments, and keep the label in the manifest that creates it.
